statement: Axod maintains exactly one open standalone (home-directory, no-workspace) Session independently of Workspace Sessions. Closing its final Session or final shell archives that record and creates a fresh standalone replacement rather than leaving the catalog without a home Session.
consequence: Without a standalone Session, the app loses the default place for ordinary terminal sessions and the session catalog may become unusable after closing its last entry.

enforcedAt.trigger: Axod closes a standalone Session or its final shell
